# Scenario: notifications.events filter advances past non-matching lines without
# sending; only git_login_failed is delivered (container_deployed stays local).

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: notify filter baseline'
cd ..

notify-hook-start

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: deploy emits container_deployed; filter skips → empty hook ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'done duration='
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-nfilt-web

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'container_deployed' $HOME/.events
exists $WORK/notify-hook.bodies
exec sh -c 'test ! -s "$WORK/notify-hook.bodies"'

git-authfail-start
cp .apinfra.authfail .apinfra

# --- Cycle 2: matching git_login_failed is delivered ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'git authentication failed'
stderr 'done duration='

grep 'git_login_failed' $HOME/.events
grep 'git_login_failed' $WORK/notify-hook.bodies
grep 'type: git_login_failed' $WORK/notify-hook.bodies
! grep 'container_deployed' $WORK/notify-hook.bodies
! grep 'type: container_deployed' $WORK/notify-hook.bodies

git-authfail-stop
notify-hook-stop

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
serverName=e2e-host
repoBranch=main
notifications.enabled=true
notifications.targets=generic+http://127.0.0.1:18100/hook
notifications.events=git_login_failed
notifications.maxPerCycle=10
notifications.cutEvery=100

-- .apinfra.authfail --
namespace=dev
serverName=e2e-host
repoBranch=main
repo=http://127.0.0.1:18081/repo
repoToken=bad-token
notifications.enabled=true
notifications.targets=generic+http://127.0.0.1:18100/hook
notifications.events=git_login_failed
notifications.maxPerCycle=10
notifications.cutEvery=100

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-nfilt
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9812
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-nfilt/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=NOTIFY_FILTER"]

-- .env --
